+/**
+ * Preregistered M5 query-blind, memory-only CRE1 medoid validity gate on DEV/VAL.
+ * The scoring routine cannot receive a query, the gold role, or a candidate identifier.
+ * A SEALED test is intentionally unsupported. The model is loaded read-only.
+ */
+object M5Cre1BlindGate {
+    const val MAX_STRICT_VAL_TOP1 = 0.175
+    private const val TIE_EPS = 1e-12
+
+    data class BlindRank(val scores: DoubleArray, val strictWinner: Int?, val tiedMaximum: Boolean)
+    data class Summary(
+        val split: M5Data.Split,
+        val groups: Int,
+        val strictHits: Int,
+        val forcedHits: Int,
+        val maxTies: Int
+    ) {
+        val strictRate: Double get() = strictHits.toDouble() / groups
+        val forcedRate: Double get() = forcedHits.toDouble() / groups
+    }
+
+    /** Score_j = sum_i <memory_i, memory_j>; query and gold are not parameters. */
+    fun rank(memories: List<DoubleArray>): BlindRank {
+        require(memories.size == 8) { "exactly 8 memories required" }
+        val d = memories[0].size
+        require(d > 0 && memories.all { it.size == d && it.all(Double::isFinite) })
+        val aggregate = DoubleArray(d)
+        for (v in memories) for (j in 0 until d) aggregate[j] += v[j]
+        val scores = DoubleArray(memories.size) { i ->
+            var dot = 0.0
+            for (j in 0 until d) dot += aggregate[j] * memories[i][j]
+            require(dot.isFinite())
+            dot
+        }
+        val max = scores.max()
+        val winners = scores.indices.filter { abs(scores[it] - max) <= TIE_EPS }
+        // Ties do not count as correct even when a deterministic argmax picks the gold index.
+        return BlindRank(scores, if (winners.size == 1) winners.single() else null, winners.size != 1)
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * The embedding callback receives ONLY the memory text. Gold and query are used
+     * exclusively by the independent scoring summary, never to choose the predicted index.
+     */
+    fun evaluate(rows: List<M5Data.Row>, split: M5Data.Split, embedMemory: (String) -> DoubleArray): Summary {
+        M5Data.validate(rows)
+        val groups = rows.groupBy { it.group }.values.filter { it[0].split == split }
+        require(groups.size == 128) { "expected 128 $split groups, got ${groups.size}" }
+        var strict = 0
+        var forced = 0
+        var ties = 0
+        for (group in groups) {
+            val records = group.filter { it.role != "QUERY" }
+            val ranked = rank(records.map { embedMemory(it.text) })
+            val goldIndex = records.indexOfFirst { it.role == "TRUE" }
+            if (ranked.strictWinner == goldIndex) strict++
+            if (ranked.tiedMaximum) ties++
+            // Extra diagnostic, not a preregistered validity gate: ties broken by slot order.
+            val forcedWinner = ranked.scores.indices.maxBy { ranked.scores[it] }
+            if (forcedWinner == goldIndex) forced++
+        }
+        return Summary(split, groups.size, strict, forced, ties)
+    }
+
+    fun gatePassed(s: Summary): Boolean =
+        s.split == M5Data.Split.VAL && s.groups == 128 &&
+            s.strictRate <= MAX_STRICT_VAL_TOP1 && s.forcedRate <= MAX_STRICT_VAL_TOP1
+
+    private fun sha256(bytes: ByteArray): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
+        .digest(bytes).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
+
+    @JvmStatic fun main(args: Array<String>) {
+        require(args.size == 5) { "usage: M5Cre1BlindGate <DEV_VAL.tsv> <frozen-CRE1-checkpoint.cre1> <expected-data-sha256> <expected-checkpoint-sha256> <audit-output.txt>" }
+        val data = File(args[0])
+        val checkpoint = File(args[1])
+        val dataExpected = args[2].lowercase()
+        val checkpointExpected = args[3].lowercase()
+        require(Regex("[0-9a-f]{64}").matches(dataExpected) && Regex("[0-9a-f]{64}").matches(checkpointExpected)) { "Expected frozen SHA-256 digests" }
+        val output = File(args[4])
+        require(data.isFile && checkpoint.isFile && !output.canonicalFile.equals(data.canonicalFile))
+        require(!output.canonicalFile.equals(checkpoint.canonicalFile))
+        val dataActual = M5Data.sha256(data)
+        require(dataActual == dataExpected) { "M5 DEV/VAL dataset changed since freeze" }
+        val snapshot = checkpoint.readBytes()
+        val checkpointActual = sha256(snapshot)
+        require(checkpointActual == checkpointExpected) { "CRE1 checkpoint changed since freeze" }
+        val rows = M5Data.read(data)
+        val cre = Cre1InferenceEncoder.restore(snapshot)
+        val embed: (String) -> DoubleArray = { memory -> cre.embed(memory, "m") }
+        val dev = evaluate(rows, M5Data.Split.DEV, embed)
+        val validation = evaluate(rows, M5Data.Split.VAL, embed)
+        val passed = gatePassed(validation)
+        val report = buildString {
+            appendLine("EXP-20 M5: CRE1 QUERY-BLIND MEDOID VALIDITY AUDIT; no SEALED opened")
+            appendLine("DATA_SHA256=$dataActual")
+            appendLine("CHECKPOINT_SHA256=$checkpointActual CHECKPOINT_STEPS=${cre.steps}")
+            for (s in listOf(dev, validation)) {
+                appendLine("${s.split} strict_top1=${s.strictHits}/${s.groups} " +
+                    "forced_top1=${s.forcedHits}/${s.groups} max_ties=${s.maxTies}")
+            }
+            appendLine("PREREG_VAL_GATE=${if (passed) "PASS" else "INVALID"}")
+            appendLine("FORCED_TOP1_IS_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; SEALED=UNOPENED; FOLD7=DEVICE_NOT_RUN")

+        output.parentFile?.mkdirs()
+        output.writeText(report, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
+        print(report)
+        check(passed) { "M5 dataset invalid under preregistered CRE1 query-blind medoid gate" }
+    }

+/**
+ * M11 · rewrites "der Bruder von Anna" / "die Schwester von Max" in a memory question into the one person the owner's

+object MemoryQuestionResolver {
+    /** "Anna ist die Schwester von Max" makes Max a sibling of Anna (Max's gender is not inferred). */
+    private val SIBLING_INVERSE = listOf("schwester_von", "bruder_von").map { p ->
+        JustifiedRelationStore.Rule("$p ⇒ geschwister (umgekehrt)", listOf(JustifiedRelationStore.Triple("?a", p, "?b")),
+            JustifiedRelationStore.Triple("?b", "geschwister_von", "?a"), distinct = listOf("?a" to "?b"))
+    }
+    private val RELATION = Regex("(?iu)\\b(?:der|den|dem|des) Bruder von (\\p{Lu}\\p{L}+)|\\b(?:die|der) Schwester von (\\p{Lu}\\p{L}+)")
+
+    fun resolve(question: String, facts: List<Pair<String, String>>): String? {
+        val m = RELATION.find(question) ?: return null
+        val anchor = m.groupValues[1].ifEmpty { m.groupValues[2] }
+        val store = JustifiedRelationStore()
+        // local rules: kept out of kinshipRules() so the existing evidence shadow and its counts stay unchanged
+        (JustifiedRelationStore.kinshipRules() + SIBLING_INVERSE).forEach(store::addRule)

+        return if (siblings.size == 1) question.replaceRange(m.range, siblings.single()) else null
+    }

+package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive
+
+/**
+ * M11 · deterministic timeline check over ACTIVE owner facts (no model, no write, no new fact).
+ *
+ * Two facts about the same named subject that share a sentence frame but differ in their values describe the same
+ * attribute at different times or contradict each other:
+ *  - a fact with "bis/früher/damals/wohnte..." is SUPERSEDED by one with "seit/jetzt/inzwischen..." (outdated);
+ *  - a fact marked "Korrektur:" or "nicht ..., sondern ..." CORRECTS the other one;
+ *  - without any marker the pair is a CONTRADICTION: the answer must ask back instead of picking one.
+ * Facts about different attributes ("wohnt in" vs "arbeitet in") share no content word and are left alone.
+ *
+ * The frozen EWM2 brain is not changed; this check reads its cited fact ids afterwards (SHADOW research).
+ */
+object MemoryTimeline {
+    enum class Relation { SUPERSEDES, CORRECTS, CONTRADICTS }
+    data class Link(val newer: String, val older: String, val relation: Relation)
+    data class Verdict(val decision: String, val factIds: List<String>, val reason: String)
+
+    private val WORD = Regex("\\p{L}[\\p{L}\\p{N}-]*|\\p{N}+")
+    private val PAST = setOf("bis", "früher", "ehemals", "zuvor", "damals", "vorher", "einst", "ursprünglich", "vormals")
+    private val CURRENT = setOf("seit", "jetzt", "inzwischen", "mittlerweile", "heute", "nun", "aktuell", "neuerdings")
+    private val STOP = setOf("der", "die", "das", "den", "dem", "des", "ein", "eine", "einen", "einem", "einer", "von", "in", "im",
+        "am", "an", "auf", "mit", "und", "ist", "sind", "war", "hat", "zu", "zum", "zur", "bei", "für", "nicht", "sondern",
+        "korrektur", "laut", "auch", "noch", "aber") + PAST + CURRENT
+
+    /** Links between facts (id to text); bounded by the caller's active-fact limit. */
+    fun links(facts: List<Pair<String, String>>): List<Link> {
+        val out = ArrayList<Link>()
+        val parsed = facts.take(200).map { (id, text) -> Parsed(id, text) }
+        for (i in parsed.indices) for (j in i + 1 until parsed.size) {
+            val a = parsed[i]; val b = parsed[j]
+            if (a.subject == null || a.subject != b.subject) continue
+            val frame = a.stems.intersect(b.stems)
+            if (frame.isEmpty()) continue                                // different attribute ("wohnt" vs "arbeitet")
+            val differing = (a.valueTokens - b.valueTokens) + (b.valueTokens - a.valueTokens)
+            if (differing.isEmpty()) continue                            // same statement repeated or paraphrased
+            out += when {
+                b.correction && !a.correction -> Link(b.id, a.id, Relation.CORRECTS)
+                a.correction && !b.correction -> Link(a.id, b.id, Relation.CORRECTS)
+                b.current && a.past -> Link(b.id, a.id, Relation.SUPERSEDES)
+                a.current && b.past -> Link(a.id, b.id, Relation.SUPERSEDES)
+                else -> Link(a.id, b.id, Relation.CONTRADICTS)
+            }
+        }
+        return out
+    }
+
+    /** What a brain answer citing [cited] should become given the timeline of [facts]. */
+    fun check(cited: List<String>, facts: List<Pair<String, String>>): Verdict {
+        val first = cited.firstOrNull() ?: return Verdict("UNCHANGED", cited, "NO_CITATION")
+        val ls = links(facts)
+        ls.firstOrNull { it.relation == Relation.CONTRADICTS && (it.newer == first || it.older == first) }
+            ?.let { return Verdict("CLARIFY", listOf(it.newer, it.older), "CONTRADICTING_FACTS") }
+        var current = first; val seen = HashSet<String>()
+        while (seen.add(current)) {
+            val newer = ls.firstOrNull { it.older == current && it.relation != Relation.CONTRADICTS } ?: break
+            current = newer.newer
+        }
+        return if (current == first) Verdict("UNCHANGED", cited, "CURRENT") else
+            Verdict("REPLACE", listOf(current) + cited.filter { it != first && it != current }, "OUTDATED_CITATION")
+    }
+
+    private class Parsed(val id: String, text: String) {
+        val tokens = WORD.findAll(text).map { it.value }.toList()
+        val lower = tokens.map { it.lowercase() }
+        /** A name: capitalised, not preceded by an article or an inflected adjective ("der Geburtstag", "roten Kombi"). */
+        private val names = tokens.indices.filter { i ->
+            val t = tokens[i]; val prev = lower.getOrNull(i - 1)
+            t[0].isUpperCase() && t.length >= 3 && lower[i] !in STOP && lower[i] !in ARTICLES &&
+                (prev == null || (prev !in ARTICLES && !ADJ.matches(prev))) &&
+                (i > 0 || tokens.getOrNull(1)?.get(0)?.isLowerCase() == true)
+        }.map { lower[it] }
+        val subject: String? = names.firstOrNull()
+        val past = lower.any { it in PAST }
+        val current = lower.any { it in CURRENT }
+        val correction = lower.firstOrNull() == "korrektur" || ("sondern" in lower && "nicht" in lower)
+        /** every content token except the subject, as a 4-letter stem ("wohnte"/"wohnt" -> "wohn") */
+        val stems: Set<String> = lower.filter { it !in STOP && it !in ARTICLES && it != subject && it.length >= 3 && !it[0].isDigit() }
+            .map { it.take(4) }.toSet()
+        /** tokens that can carry a value: numbers, names, inflected adjectives ("roten") */
+        val valueTokens: Set<String> = lower.filterIndexed { i, t -> t != subject &&
+            (t[0].isDigit() || t in names || ADJ.matches(t) && lower.getOrNull(i + 1)?.let { n -> tokens[i + 1][0].isUpperCase() } == true) }.toSet()
+    }
+
+    private val ARTICLES = setOf("der", "die", "das", "den", "dem", "des", "ein", "eine", "einen", "einem", "einer", "eines")
+    private val ADJ = Regex("\\p{L}{3,}(e|en|er|es|em)")
+}

+package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive
+
+import at.heinz.deviceai.intelligence.ewm.Ewm1ClaimCheck
+
+/**
+ * SHADOW audit of a finished local-model answer against the retrieval it was given in the same turn.
+ *
+ * It connects the existing deterministic claim check (EWM2 H4) to the generative Gemma path, which never ran it:
+ * names/nouns, numbers, time words and colours of the answer must occur in the evidence, and the polarity of each
+ * answer sentence must match the evidence sentence it overlaps most. (Ewm1ClaimCheck compares polarity across the
+ * whole evidence, which was right for its one-fact answers but flags every answer once a multi-sentence retrieval
+ * contains any "nicht"; the frozen check itself is not changed.)
+ *
+ * The result is ONE trace stage in the existing metadata-only turn trace, nothing else: the visible answer, the
+ * prompt, model calls, tools and memories are unchanged, and no token of the answer or the evidence is stored.
+ *
+ * Limits, stated so nobody reads more into it: this is token and polarity matching, not entailment. A flag means
+ * "a detail is not carried by the retrieval" (the model may have added a legitimate conclusion); a pass does not
+ * prove the answer correct. It becomes a quality signal only together with owner feedback on the same trace.
+ */
+object LocalModelClaimAudit {
+    /** Answers longer than the model's bounded reply are not audited (the stage then says so). */
+    const val MAX_ANSWER_CHARS = 8_000
+    private val POLARITY = setOf("Verneinung fehlt", "unbelegte Verneinung", "Ja trotz Verneinung")
+    private val SENTENCE_END = Regex("(?<=[.!?])\\s+")
+    private val CONTENT_WORD = Regex("\\p{L}{4,}")
+
+    fun stage(answer: String, recall: LocalGroundedRecall): TraceStage {
+        if (answer.isBlank() || answer.length > MAX_ANSWER_CHARS) return TraceStage.CLAIM_AUDIT_SKIPPED
+        return runCatching {
+            if (unsupportedDetails(answer, listOf(recall.answer, recall.provenance)) ||
+                polarityMismatch(answer, sentences(recall.answer))) TraceStage.CLAIM_AUDIT_UNSUPPORTED
+            else TraceStage.CLAIM_AUDIT_SUPPORTED
+        }.getOrDefault(TraceStage.CLAIM_AUDIT_SKIPPED)
+    }
+
+    private fun unsupportedDetails(answer: String, evidence: List<String>): Boolean =
+        Ewm1ClaimCheck.check(answer, evidence).unsupported.any { it !in POLARITY }
+
+    private fun polarityMismatch(answer: String, evidence: List<String>): Boolean = sentences(answer).any { sentence ->
+        val words = contentWords(sentence)
+        val best = evidence.maxByOrNull { e -> contentWords(e).count { it in words } }
+        best != null && contentWords(best).any { it in words } &&
+            Ewm1ClaimCheck.check(sentence, listOf(best)).unsupported.any { it in POLARITY }
+    }
+
+    private fun sentences(text: String): List<String> = text.split(SENTENCE_END).map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
+    private fun contentWords(text: String): Set<String> = CONTENT_WORD.findAll(text.lowercase()).map { it.value }.toSet()
+}

+ * flags, unresolved references, freshness, tool intent, device state):
+ *
+ *   EU(a | s) = p(a, s) · V  −  h(a, s) · R  −  λ_t · t(a)  −  λ_e · e(a)
+ *
+ * p = probability the turn ends correct, h = probability of a confident wrong answer, V = value of a correct answer,
+ * R = cost of a wrong one (R ≫ V for owner facts), t/e = expected latency and energy. p and h come from Beta posteriors
+ * per (action, signal bin) that start at conservative priors and are updated only from verified outcomes (owner
+ * feedback, claim check, independent tests). This is metareasoning in the sense of Russell & Wefald (1991); the
+ * calibration-table form is our own choice for an on-device, auditable router.

+    private val costs: Costs = Costs(),

+        val evidence: EvidenceDecision,

+        val claimFlags: Int,             // details the claim check could not ground in the last draft
+        val unresolvedReference: Boolean,
+        val freshnessNeeded: Boolean,
+        val toolIntent: Boolean,
+        val personal: Boolean,           // the answer would state an owner fact
+        val modelReady: Boolean,
+        val internetAllowed: Boolean,

+        val remainingModelCalls: Int = 4

+    // ---- internals -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    private fun correction(text: String): Resolution? {
+        val m = CORRECTION.matchEntire(text) ?: return null
+        val target = m.groupValues[1].trim().trimEnd('.', '!', '?').replace(Regex("(?iu)^(den|dem|der|die|das|meine[nmr]?|mein)\\s+"), "")
+        val previous = lastResolution ?: return Resolution(text, text, Decision.CLARIFY, emptyList(), temporal, true, "CORRECTION_WITHOUT_QUESTION")
+        val question = lastQuestion ?: return Resolution(text, text, Decision.CLARIFY, emptyList(), temporal, true, "CORRECTION_WITHOUT_QUESTION")
+        val label = target.split(Regex("\\s+")).last()
+        if (!label.first().isUpperCase()) return Resolution(text, text, Decision.CLARIFY, emptyList(), temporal, true, "CORRECTION_TARGET_UNCLEAR")
+        val key = Ewm1Lexicon.lower(label)
+        touch(Mention(key, label, entities[key]?.kind ?: Kind.PERSON, entities[key]?.gender), countMention = true)
+        // The wrongly bound referent is excluded for this word from now on; the question is asked again with the target.
+        val wrong = previous.bindings.lastOrNull()
+        var rewritten = question
+        val bindings = ArrayList<Binding>()
+        if (wrong != null) {
+            rejected += wrong.word + "|" + wrong.entity
+            rewritten = replaceWord(previous.rewritten, entities[wrong.entity]?.label ?: wrong.entity, label)
+            bindings += Binding(wrong.word, key, "Korrektur durch den Besitzer")
+        } else {
+            rewritten = question.trimEnd('?', '.', '!') + " (gemeint: $label)?"
+            bindings += Binding("?", key, "Korrektur durch den Besitzer")
+        }
+        val r = Resolution(text, rewritten, Decision.RESOLVED, bindings, previous.temporal, true, "CORRECTED")
+        lastResolution = r
+        return r
+    }

+    private fun candidates(word: String, wanted: Set<Kind>): List<EntityRef> {
+        val gender: Set<Char>? = when (word) {
+            // "er/ihn/ihm" take a masculine antecedent ("der Ofen"), a neuter one takes "es"; possessives allow both
+            "er", "ihn", "ihm" -> setOf('m')
+            "sein", "seine", "seinen", "seinem", "seiner", "dessen" -> setOf('m', 'n')
+            "sie", "ihr", "ihre", "ihren", "ihrem", "ihrer", "deren" -> setOf('f')
+            "es" -> setOf('n')
+            else -> null
+        }
+        return entities.values.filter { e ->
+            e.kind in wanted && "$word|${e.key}" !in rejected &&
+                (gender == null || e.gender == null || e.gender in gender) &&
+                // "er/sie" for a thing needs the article's gender; an unknown-gender thing is not a person referent
+                !(e.kind == Kind.THING && gender != null && e.gender == null) &&
+                turn - e.lastTurn <= WINDOW
+        }.sortedByDescending { score(it, word) }
+    }
+
+    private fun score(e: EntityRef): Double = 1.0 / (1 + turn - e.lastTurn) + 0.05 * minOf(e.mentions, 4)
+
+    /** A referent whose gender is known from a role or article outranks one whose gender is only "not excluded". */
+    private fun score(e: EntityRef, word: String): Double = score(e) + if (e.gender != null && word in GENDERED) 0.5 else 0.0
+
+    private data class Mention(val key: String, val label: String, val kind: Kind, val gender: Char?, val index: Int = -1)
+
+    private fun mentions(tokens: List<String>, questionText: Boolean = false): List<Mention> {
+        val out = ArrayList<Mention>()
+        for ((i, w) in tokens.withIndex()) {
+            val lower = Ewm1Lexicon.lower(w)
+            val prev = tokens.getOrNull(i - 1)?.let(Ewm1Lexicon::lower)
+            val roleGender = roleGender(lower)
+            if (roleGender != null && prev != null && prev.startsWith("mein") || roleGender != null && prev != null && prev.startsWith("unser")) {
+                val name = tokens.getOrNull(i + 1)
+                if (name != null && name.first().isUpperCase() && Ewm1Lexicon.lower(name) !in Ewm1Lexicon.FUNCTION) continue
+                out += Mention(lower, w, Kind.PERSON, roleGender, i); continue
+            }
+            if (!w.first().isUpperCase() || lower in Ewm1Lexicon.FUNCTION || lower in NON_REFERENTS || lower in PRONOUNS) continue
+            if (i == 0) {
+                // "Anna wohnt in Linz.": a sentence-initial capital followed by a lowercase verb is taken as a name mention
+                val known = entities[lower]
+                if (known != null) out += Mention(lower, w, known.kind, known.gender, i)
+                // ... but not the verb of a verb-first question ("Funktioniert er jetzt?", "Wohnt sie dort?")
+                else if (tokens.getOrNull(1)?.first()?.isLowerCase() == true && !questionText &&
+                    Ewm1Lexicon.lower(tokens[1]) !in PRONOUNS && Ewm1Lexicon.lower(tokens[1]) !in OBJECT_PRONOUNS &&
+                    Ewm1Lexicon.lower(tokens[1]) !in Ewm1Lexicon.FUNCTION && !nounShaped(lower))
+                    out += Mention(lower, w, Kind.PERSON, null, i)
+                continue
+            }
+            val before = tokens.getOrNull(i - 1)
+            val roleBefore = before?.let { roleGender(Ewm1Lexicon.lower(it)) }
+            val prev2 = tokens.getOrNull(i - 2)?.let(Ewm1Lexicon::lower)
+            when {
+                roleBefore != null -> out += Mention(lower, w, Kind.PERSON, roleBefore, i)
+                entities[lower] != null -> out += Mention(lower, w, entities.getValue(lower).kind, entities.getValue(lower).gender, i)
+                prev in PLACE_PREPOSITIONS -> out += Mention(lower, w, Kind.PLACE, null, i)
+                prev in ARTICLE_GENDER.keys -> out += Mention(lower, w, Kind.THING, ARTICLE_GENDER[prev], i)
+                // "einen kurzen Witz", "ein gutes Frühstück": article, adjective, noun
+                prev2 in ARTICLE_GENDER.keys && prev != null && prev.first().isLowerCase() -> out += Mention(lower, w, Kind.THING, ARTICLE_GENDER[prev2], i)
+                // "ruhige Musik", "gegen Müdigkeit", "Photosynthese": bare nouns are things, not people
+                prev != null && (prev in NOUN_PREPOSITIONS || ADJECTIVE_ENDING.matches(prev)) || nounShaped(lower) ->
+                    out += Mention(lower, w, Kind.THING, null, i)
+                else -> out += Mention(lower, w, Kind.PERSON, null, i)
+            }
+        }
+        return out
+    }
+
+    private fun remember(text: String, rest: List<Mention>, r: Resolution) {
+        rest.forEach { touch(it, countMention = true) }
+        // a resolved pronoun refreshes its referent: "Und wo wohnt sie?" keeps Anna salient
+        r.bindings.forEach { b -> entities[b.entity]?.let { entities[b.entity] = it.copy(lastTurn = turn, mentions = it.mentions + 1) } }
+        if (text.endsWith("?") || QUESTION_START.containsMatchIn(text)) {
+            lastQuestion = text
+            openQuestions.addLast(r.rewritten); while (openQuestions.size > 4) openQuestions.removeFirst()
+        }
+        lastResolution = r
+    }
+
+    private fun touch(m: Mention, countMention: Boolean) {
+        val old = entities[m.key]
+        entities.remove(m.key)
+        entities[m.key] = EntityRef(m.key, old?.label ?: m.label, old?.kind ?: m.kind, old?.gender ?: m.gender, turn,
+            (old?.mentions ?: 0) + if (countMention) 1 else 0)
+        while (entities.size > maxEntities) entities.remove(entities.values.minByOrNull { score(it) }!!.key)
+    }
+
+    private fun demonstrativeUse(tokens: List<String>, index: Int): Boolean {
+        // "Wann war das?" / "Wer hat das gesagt?": no noun follows; "das Auto" is an article
+        val next = tokens.getOrNull(index + 1) ?: return true
+        return !next.first().isUpperCase()
+    }

+    internal fun parseTime(text: String): TemporalScope? {
+        val t = Ewm1Lexicon.lower(text)
+        val d = today()
+        fun day(x: LocalDate, e: String) = TemporalScope(x, x, e)

+            "vorgestern" in t -> day(d.minusDays(2), "vorgestern")
+            "gestern" in t -> day(d.minusDays(1), "gestern")
+            "übermorgen" in t -> day(d.plusDays(2), "übermorgen")

+            Regex("\\bheute\\b").containsMatchIn(t) -> day(d, "heute")
+            Regex("letzte[nr]? woche|vorige[nr]? woche").containsMatchIn(t) -> {
+                val monday = d.with(TemporalAdjusters.previousOrSame(DayOfWeek.MONDAY)).minusWeeks(1)
+                TemporalScope(monday, monday.plusDays(6), "letzte Woche")
+            }
+            Regex("nächste[nr]? woche").containsMatchIn(t) -> {
+                val monday = d.with(TemporalAdjusters.next(DayOfWeek.MONDAY))
+                TemporalScope(monday, monday.plusDays(6), "nächste Woche")
+            }
+            Regex("diese[nr]? woche").containsMatchIn(t) -> {
+                val monday = d.with(TemporalAdjusters.previousOrSame(DayOfWeek.MONDAY))
+                TemporalScope(monday, monday.plusDays(6), "diese Woche")
+            }
+            Regex("letzte[nr]? monat|vorige[nr]? monat").containsMatchIn(t) -> {
+                val first = d.withDayOfMonth(1).minusMonths(1)
+                TemporalScope(first, first.plusMonths(1).minusDays(1), "letzten Monat")
+            }
+            else -> {
+                WEEKDAYS.entries.firstOrNull { (name, _) -> Regex("\\bam $name\\b").containsMatchIn(t) }?.let { (name, dow) ->
+                    val future = FUTURE.containsMatchIn(t)

+                MONTHS.entries.firstOrNull { (name, _) -> Regex("\\bim $name\\b").containsMatchIn(t) }?.let { (name, month) ->
+                    var first = d.withMonth(month).withDayOfMonth(1)
+                    if (first.isAfter(d) && !FUTURE.containsMatchIn(t)) first = first.minusYears(1)

+                }
+                null
+            }
+        }
+    }

+    /** Days between the scope and today, for tests and the router (negative = past). */

+    companion object {

+        private val OBJECT_PRONOUNS = setOf("mir", "mich", "dir", "dich", "uns", "euch", "bitte", "mal", "doch")
+        private val ADJECTIVE_ENDING = Regex("\\p{Ll}{2,}(e|en|er|es|em)")
+        private val NOUN_SUFFIX = Regex(".{3,}(ung|heit|keit|schaft|ion|tät|nis|ismus|ment|ik|ie|ur|ei|ese|enz|anz)")
+        private val PERSON_WORDS = setOf("beruflich", "besucht", "besuchen", "erzählt", "gesagt", "kommt", "fährt", "arbeitet",
+            "lebt", "heißt", "geboren", "alt", "geht", "ruft", "schreibt", "denkt", "meint", "mag")
+        private val GENDERED = setOf("er", "ihn", "ihm", "sie", "ihr", "ihre", "ihren", "ihrem", "ihrer", "deren",
+            "sein", "seine", "seinen", "seinem", "seiner", "dessen")

+        private val NON_REFERENTS = setOf("bitte", "danke", "hallo", "ja", "nein", "okay", "gemeint", "thema", "woche", "monat",
+            "jahr", "tag", "uhr", "montag", "dienstag", "mittwoch", "donnerstag", "freitag", "samstag", "sonntag")
+        private val TOPIC_SWITCH = Regex("(?iu)^(anderes|neues) thema\\b")

+        internal fun words(text: String): List<String> = Regex("[\\p{L}][\\p{L}\\p{N}'-]*").findAll(text).map { it.value }.toList()
+
+        private fun replaceWord(text: String, word: String, by: String): String =
+            Regex("(?<![\\p{L}])" + Regex.escape(word) + "(?![\\p{L}])").replaceFirst(text, Regex.escapeReplacement(by))
+    }

+/** EWM2 router on own synthetic facts and sources (none from DEV5, DEV5b or TEST5); B0 is a stub that keeps memory order. */
+class Ewm1BrainTest {
+    private var n = 0
+    private fun rec(title: String, text: String) = ContinuumKnowledgeArchive.SourceRecord(

+    private fun brain(facts: List<String>, vararg sources: Pair<String, String>) =
+        Ewm1Brain(facts.mapIndexed { i, f -> "f$i" to f }, Ewm1SourceIndex(sources.map { rec(it.first, it.second) })) { _, s -> s.toList() }
+
+    private fun Ewm1Brain.text(a: Ewm1Brain.Answer) = a.cited.map { if (it.startsWith("SOURCE:")) it else workspace.memory.byId.getValue(it).text }

+        assertEquals("SOURCE", general.route)
+        assertTrue(general.cited.single().startsWith("SOURCE:"))
+        assertEquals(listOf("Jonas wohnt in Gmunden."), b.text(b.ask("Wo wohnt mein Neffe?")).take(1))
+        // the frame's "mir" does not make a general question personal

+    }

+        val who = b.ask("Wer ist Jonas?")

+        assertEquals("Mein Neffe heißt Jonas.", b.text(who).first())

+    @Test fun aSourceNeverBecomesAnOwnerFact() {

+package at.heinz.deviceai.intelligence.ewm1
+
+import at.heinz.deviceai.intelligence.ewm1.Ewm1Lexicon.lower
+import at.heinz.deviceai.intelligence.ewm1.Ewm1Lexicon.stem
+
+/**
+ * Deterministic claim check of a model answer against the evidence it was given (no model call).
+ * Checks only what can be checked: names/nouns, numbers, time words, colours, negation and simple antonyms.
+ * A pass does not confirm the answer; a flag means "this detail is not carried by the evidence".
+ */
+object Ewm1ClaimCheck {
+    data class Result(val flagged: Boolean, val unsupported: List<String>)
+
+    private val PRONOUN_LIKE = setOf("er", "sie", "es", "du", "dein", "deine", "deinem", "deinen", "deiner", "ihr", "ihre",
+        "ja", "nein", "das", "die", "der", "dort", "darin", "inzwischen", "ab", "seit", "im", "in", "am", "auf", "bei",
+        "mit", "ich", "wir", "ihm", "ihn", "jetzt", "heute", "dann", "also")
+    private val TIME_SYNONYMS = listOf(setOf("früh", "morgen", "morgens", "vormittag"), setOf("abend", "abends"),
+        setOf("nacht", "nachts"), setOf("jänner", "januar"))
+
+    fun check(answer: String, evidence: List<String>): Result {
+        val a = Ewm1Tokens.of(answer)
+        val ev = evidence.flatMap { Ewm1Tokens.of(it) }
+        val evWords = ev.map { it.lower }.toSet()
+        val evNumbers = ev.mapNotNull { numberOf(it) }.toSet()
+        val unsupported = ArrayList<String>()
+
+        for (t in a) {
+            val w = t.lower
+            val n = numberOf(t)
+            if (n != null) { if (n !in evNumbers) unsupported += t.text; continue }
+            if (w in Ewm1Lexicon.COLORS || w.split('-').let { p -> p.size > 1 && p.all { it in Ewm1Lexicon.COLORS } }) {
+                if (w !in evWords) unsupported += t.text; continue
+            }
+            if (w in Ewm1Lexicon.TIME && w !in setOf("seit", "jeden", "jede", "heute")) {
+                if (w !in evWords && TIME_SYNONYMS.none { w in it && it.any { s -> s in evWords } }) unsupported += t.text
+                continue
+            }
+            if (!t.capitalized || w in PRONOUN_LIKE || w in Ewm1Lexicon.GENERIC) continue
+            if (t.sentenceInitial && w in Ewm1Lexicon.FUNCTION) continue
+            if (w in Ewm1Lexicon.FUNCTION) continue
+            if (!ev.any { e -> sameWord(w, e.lower) }) unsupported += t.text
+        }
+        // Polarity: an affirmed detail the evidence negates, or a negation the evidence does not state.
+        val evNegated = ev.any { it.lower in Ewm1Lexicon.NEGATIONS }
+        val ansNegated = a.any { it.lower in Ewm1Lexicon.NEGATIONS }
+        if (evNegated && !ansNegated) unsupported += "Verneinung fehlt"
+        if (!evNegated && ansNegated && a.none { it.lower == "mehr" }) unsupported += "unbelegte Verneinung"
+        if (a.firstOrNull()?.lower == "ja" && evNegated) unsupported += "Ja trotz Verneinung"
+        for ((x, y) in Ewm1Lexicon.ANTONYMS) for ((p, q) in listOf(x to y, y to x))
+            if (a.any { it.lower == p } && p !in evWords && q in evWords) unsupported += p
+        return Result(unsupported.isNotEmpty(), unsupported.distinct())
+    }
+
+    private fun numberOf(t: Ewm1Token): String? {
+        if (t.lower in setOf("ein", "eine", "einen", "einem", "einer")) return null
+        return Ewm1Lexicon.numberValue(t.lower)
+    }
+
+    private fun sameWord(a: String, b: String): Boolean =
+        a == b || (a.length >= 4 && b.length >= 4 && stem(a) == stem(b)) ||
+            (a.length >= 4 && (b.endsWith(a) || b.startsWith(a))) || (b.length >= 4 && (a.endsWith(b) || a.startsWith(b))) ||
+            b.split('-').any { it == a } || a.split('-').any { it == b }

+package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive
+
+import java.util.Locale
+
+/**
+ * Research-only before/after comparison for the existing HybridMemoryRetriever.
+ *
+ * This class never installs a scorer or promotes model weights, memory claims,
+ * or owner permissions. The candidate scorer must be a trusted local callback:
+ * an arbitrary callback could export the memory/query text it receives.
+ *
+ * The caller is responsible for freezing independent holdout questions before
+ * tuning the candidate, and for retaining independent build and device evidence.
+ */
+data class MemoryResearchShadowComparison(
+    val developmentBaseline: MemoryResearchSummary,
+    val developmentCandidate: MemoryResearchSummary,
+    val holdoutBaseline: MemoryResearchSummary,
+    val holdoutCandidate: MemoryResearchSummary,
+    val developmentImproved: Boolean,
+    val holdoutImproved: Boolean,
+    val noPerProbeRegression: Boolean,
+    val eligibleForOwnerReview: Boolean
+)
+
+object MemoryResearchShadowComparator {
+    fun compare(
+        developmentProbes: List<MemoryResearchProbe>,
+        frozenHoldoutProbes: List<MemoryResearchProbe>,
+        records: Collection<MemoryRecord>,
+        allowedPrivacy: Set<PrivacyClass>,
+        candidateSemanticScorer: (String, MemoryRecord) -> Double,
+        limit: Int = 8,
+        nowMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
+    ): MemoryResearchShadowComparison {
+        require(developmentProbes.size in 1..64)
+        require(frozenHoldoutProbes.size in 1..64)
+        require(records.size <= 2_000)
+        require(records.map { it.id }.toSet().size == records.size) {
+            "Duplicate memory identifiers"
+        }
+        val allProbes = developmentProbes + frozenHoldoutProbes
+        require(allProbes.map { it.id }.toSet().size == allProbes.size) {
+            "Development and holdout probe IDs overlap"
+        }
+        val developmentQueries = developmentProbes.map { it.query.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }.toSet()
+        val holdoutQueries = frozenHoldoutProbes.map { it.query.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }.toSet()
+        require(developmentQueries.intersect(holdoutQueries).isEmpty()) {
+            "Development and holdout questions overlap"
+        }
+        require(frozenHoldoutProbes.map { it.ability }.toSet() ==
+            MemoryResearchAbility.values().toSet()) {
+            "Frozen holdout must cover all five memory abilities"
+        }
+
+        val memoryById = records.associateBy { it.id }
+        allProbes.flatMap { it.expectedMemoryIds }.forEach { id ->
+            val gold = memoryById[id]
+            require(gold != null && gold.privacyClass in allowedPrivacy &&
+                gold.validationState == ValidationState.VERIFIED &&
+                gold.provenance !in setOf(
+                    ProvenanceType.MODEL_GENERATED,
+                    ProvenanceType.INFERENCE,
+                    ProvenanceType.UNVERIFIED
+                )) {
+                "Expected answer is missing, privacy-forbidden or not independently verified"
+            }
+        }
+
+        fun run(probes: List<MemoryResearchProbe>, scorer: ((String, MemoryRecord) -> Double)?):
+            MemoryResearchSummary = MemoryRetrievalResearchGate.evaluate(
+                probes = probes,
+                records = records,
+                allowedPrivacy = allowedPrivacy,
+                limit = limit,
+                nowMillis = nowMillis,
+                semanticScorer = scorer
+            )
+
+        val developmentBaseline = run(developmentProbes, null)
+        val developmentCandidate = run(developmentProbes, candidateSemanticScorer)
+        val holdoutBaseline = run(frozenHoldoutProbes, null)
+        val holdoutCandidate = run(frozenHoldoutProbes, candidateSemanticScorer)
+
+        val developmentSafe = doesNotRegress(developmentBaseline, developmentCandidate)
+        val holdoutSafe = doesNotRegress(holdoutBaseline, holdoutCandidate)
+        val developmentImproved = developmentSafe &&
+            strictlyImproves(developmentBaseline, developmentCandidate)
+        val holdoutImproved = holdoutSafe &&
+            strictlyImproves(holdoutBaseline, holdoutCandidate)
+
+        return MemoryResearchShadowComparison(
+            developmentBaseline = developmentBaseline,
+            developmentCandidate = developmentCandidate,
+            holdoutBaseline = holdoutBaseline,
+            holdoutCandidate = holdoutCandidate,
+            developmentImproved = developmentImproved,
+            holdoutImproved = holdoutImproved,
+            noPerProbeRegression = developmentSafe && holdoutSafe,
+            eligibleForOwnerReview = developmentImproved && holdoutImproved
+        )
+    }
+
+    private fun doesNotRegress(
+        baseline: MemoryResearchSummary,
+        candidate: MemoryResearchSummary
+    ): Boolean = baseline.results.size == candidate.results.size &&
+        baseline.results.zip(candidate.results).all { (before, after) ->
+            before.probeId == after.probeId &&
+                (!before.correctTopOneOrAbstention || after.correctTopOneOrAbstention) &&
+                (!before.anyExpectedWithinLimit || after.anyExpectedWithinLimit) &&
+                after.reciprocalRank + 1e-12 >= before.reciprocalRank
+        }
+
+    private fun strictlyImproves(
+        baseline: MemoryResearchSummary,
+        candidate: MemoryResearchSummary
+    ): Boolean = baseline.results.zip(candidate.results).any { (before, after) ->
+        (!before.correctTopOneOrAbstention && after.correctTopOneOrAbstention) ||
+            (!before.anyExpectedWithinLimit && after.anyExpectedWithinLimit) ||
+            after.reciprocalRank > before.reciprocalRank + 1e-12
+    }
+}

+package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive
+
+/**
+ * Research-only evaluation of the EXISTING local hybrid memory retriever.
+ *
+ * LongMemEval-inspired assessment without importing a benchmark runtime or
+ * giving external questions access to owner memory. Callers supply synthetic,
+ * consented and/or already privacy-scoped records. No memory writes, training,
+ * model calls, tool execution or promotion are performed.
+ */
+enum class MemoryResearchAbility {
+    STATIC_RECALL,
+    DYNAMIC_STATE,
+    WORKFLOW,
+    ENVIRONMENT_GOTCHA,
+    PREMISE_AWARENESS
+}
+
+data class MemoryResearchProbe(
+    val id: String,
+    val ability: MemoryResearchAbility,
+    val query: String,
+    val expectedMemoryIds: Set<String>
+) {
+    init {
+        require(id.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,96}")))
+        require(query.isNotBlank() && query.length <= 512)
+        require(expectedMemoryIds.size <= 16)
+        require(expectedMemoryIds.none(String::isBlank))
+    }
+}
+
+data class MemoryResearchProbeResult(
+    val probeId: String,
+    val ability: MemoryResearchAbility,
+    val expectedAbstention: Boolean,
+    val correctTopOneOrAbstention: Boolean,
+    val anyExpectedWithinLimit: Boolean,
+    val reciprocalRank: Double,
+    val durationNanos: Long
+) {
+    init {
+        require(reciprocalRank.isFinite() && reciprocalRank in 0.0..1.0)
+        require(durationNanos >= 0L)
+    }
+}
+
+data class MemoryResearchSummary(
+    val count: Int,
+    val topOneOrAbstentionAccuracy: Double,
+    val hitRateAtLimit: Double,
+    val meanReciprocalRank: Double,
+    val totalDurationNanos: Long,
+    val results: List<MemoryResearchProbeResult>
+) {
+    init {
+        require(count == results.size)
+        require(listOf(topOneOrAbstentionAccuracy, hitRateAtLimit, meanReciprocalRank)
+            .all { it.isFinite() && it in 0.0..1.0 })
+        require(totalDurationNanos >= 0L)
+    }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Shadow quality gate over HybridMemoryRetriever: the production retrieval
+ * algorithm, owner-authority checks, evidence flags and CRE1 remain untouched.
+ * Returning only metrics (not memory content) prevents benchmark reports
+ * becoming a second unauthorized personal-memory export path.
+ */
+object MemoryRetrievalResearchGate {
+    fun evaluate(
+        probes: List<MemoryResearchProbe>,
+        records: Collection<MemoryRecord>,
+        allowedPrivacy: Set<PrivacyClass>,
+        limit: Int = 8,
+        nowMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
+        semanticScorer: ((String, MemoryRecord) -> Double)? = null,
+        nanoClock: () -> Long = System::nanoTime
+    ): MemoryResearchSummary {
+        require(probes.size in 1..64) { "Provide between 1 and 64 bounded memory probes" }
+        require(probes.map { it.id }.distinct().size == probes.size) { "Duplicate probe identifiers" }
+        require(records.size <= 2_000) { "Oversized local benchmark corpus" }
+        require(records.map { it.id }.toSet().size == records.size) {
+            "Duplicate memory identifiers make benchmark results ambiguous"
+        }
+        require(limit in 1..32)
+        require(nowMillis >= 0L)
+        require(allowedPrivacy.isNotEmpty())
+        val availableIds = records.filter { it.privacyClass in allowedPrivacy }.map { it.id }.toSet()
+        require(probes.all { availableIds.containsAll(it.expectedMemoryIds) }) {
+            "Probe references a missing or privacy-forbidden memory"
+        }
+        val results = probes.map { probe ->
+            val start = nanoClock()
+            val hits = HybridMemoryRetriever.retrieve(
+                query = probe.query,
+                records = records,
+                limit = limit,
+                nowMillis = nowMillis,
+                allowedPrivacy = allowedPrivacy,
+                semanticScorer = semanticScorer
+            )
+            val end = nanoClock()
+            // nanoTime wraps safely for short intervals on supported JVMs.
+            val elapsed = (end - start).coerceAtLeast(0L)
+            val firstRank = hits.indexOfFirst { it.memory.id in probe.expectedMemoryIds }
+            val abstention = probe.expectedMemoryIds.isEmpty()
+            MemoryResearchProbeResult(
+                probeId = probe.id,
+                ability = probe.ability,
+                expectedAbstention = abstention,
+                correctTopOneOrAbstention = if (abstention) hits.isEmpty() else firstRank == 0,
+                anyExpectedWithinLimit = if (abstention) hits.isEmpty() else firstRank >= 0,
+                reciprocalRank = if (firstRank >= 0) 1.0 / (firstRank + 1) else 0.0,
+                durationNanos = elapsed
+            )
+        }
+        val denominator = results.size.toDouble()
+        val duration = results.fold(0L) { sum, result ->
+            if (Long.MAX_VALUE - sum < result.durationNanos) Long.MAX_VALUE
+            else sum + result.durationNanos
+        }
+        return MemoryResearchSummary(
+            count = results.size,
+            topOneOrAbstentionAccuracy =
+                results.count { it.correctTopOneOrAbstention } / denominator,
+            hitRateAtLimit = results.count { it.anyExpectedWithinLimit } / denominator,
+            meanReciprocalRank = results.sumOf { it.reciprocalRank } / denominator,
+            totalDurationNanos = duration,
+            results = results.toList()
+        )
+    }
+}
